basic_info.description: $100k+ PRICE REDUCTION! Prime Investment Opportunity or Owner User in Noe Valley: 2-Unit VACANT Mixed-Use Building on Church Street  Overview:  Discover an exceptional investment opportunity in the heart of San Francisco's coveted Noe Valley neighborhood. This charming 2-unit mixed-use building, situated on bustling Church Street, seamlessly blends commercial and residential spaces, offering unparalleled potential for both investors and owner-occupiers.  Commercial Space:  Ground Floor - Fully Equipped Restaurant Step into a thriving restaurant space on the ground floor, complete with a full kitchen, modern appliances, and tasteful decor. This turnkey establishment boasts a loyal customer base and enjoys significant foot traffic, making it an ideal venture for restaurateurs or savvy investors looking to capitalize on the area's vibrant dining scene.  Residential Space:  Upstairs - Spacious 3 Bedroom, 2 Bathroom Flat Ascend to the upper level, where you'll find a beautifully appointed 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom flat. This residence offers a perfect blend of comfort and style, featuring living room, dining room and eat-in kitchen, and ample natural light.
